timing: post-first-study-results interpretation review, before candidate completion; not a preregistration amendment
holm_null: two-sided zero mean paired-seed area difference
practical_margin: nominal CI cut at -0.001 for improvement, +0.001 for regression; these are not simultaneous confidence bounds at the practical margin
signflip: all8 sign patterns are enumerated; valid reference interpretation requires exchangeable/symmetric paired-difference signs. Not design-based randomized assignment and not distribution-free inference under a mean-zero null alone.
